Ever wonder what an artist does on vacation? 
They do more art stuff [of course]!!! 

Highlights of our time away in Delaware last week include being up before dawn to see two very glorious sunrises, finishing a book [The Grand Affair: John Singer Sargent in His World by Paul Fisher] and starting a new one [My Name Is Asher Lev by Chaim Potok], catching a very cloudy sunset on an interesting weather day where the sun had a glowing ring all day, visiting the Rehoboth Art League, using our camera to capture colors and textures to incorporate into artwork in the future, and soaking it all in while spending time eating, drinking, and relaxing with the family. 

Thank you for allowing us to share these highlights with all of you and more importantly for your continued support that granted us this opportunity to escape for a bit and come back re-charged and ready for the busy season ahead of us!
